header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
Petitioner: Through Mr. Mir Muhammad Nohri, Advocate
body: 2. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has claimed appointment against deceased quota available under Rule 11 - A of the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion & Transfer) Rule, 1974 (APT Rules).

3. It is the case of the Petitioner that his father was employed in police department and passed away while in service in year 2018. Petitioner approached the Respondents to consider his case for appointment but to no avail. Learned Counsel therefore prays for appropriate directions.

4. Learned Additional Advocate General, present in Court in other matters waives notice and submits that department has constituted scrutiny committee to finalize the cases under deceased quota, and submits that the case may be sent to the said committee for decision in accordance with law.

5. Per Learned AAG, Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
6. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
